== The Mazrim Taim vs Demandred theory. ==

In 1998 the information that has come to light about [[Taim]] and [[Demandred]] was not available to Ryan R (that's as far as I can tell...I went through thirteen search pages looking for Robert Jordan's denial that Taim is Demandred and the earliest I could find was Jan 2003...but there were several more pages to peruse so something earlier could have been in them...I fouond a 1994 RAFO, but nothing else).  So the individual can be forgiven for supporting the now-thoroughly-debunked theory that Taim is Demandred. I thought, however, that no article asserting such theory ought to stand without comment from the editors in case persons new to the [[Wheel]] might take it as Gospel Truth. There is, however, no reason to completely debunk, IMHO, the theory that Taim is a [[Forsaken]].  He may be [[Moridin]]/[[Ishamael]], who was in one of his periods of freedom from his imprisonment at [[Shayol Ghul]], which would explain why he was around before the events at the Eye of the World.  If, however, that is not the case, then it is unlikely that Moridin is Taim, whose article dates his birth at 967 NE.  Which lends credence to the "not Ishamael" theory, unless Ishamael murdered the original Taim and took his place...a plausible possibility.[[User:Pedantic|Pedantic]] 00:30, May 20, 2012 (UTC)
